work.name: Ant Group
work.summary: Worked on confidential LLM computing, federated learning, secure multi-party computation (MPC) and trusted execution environments (TEE).
highlights: Confidential LLM computing. Confidential LLM inference in TEEs (SGX, HyperEnclave) with remote attestation; federated fine-tuning of LLMs across institutions.
Federated learning. An automated attack-and-defense framework open-sourced in SecretFlow, with benchmarks across models and scenarios.

MPC and TEE (TECC). ABY3 operators, SGX and HyperEnclave adaptation, cloud deployment; co-wrote the white paper; 1 software copyright and a CAICT certificate. TECC was selected as one of the Top Ten Hardcore Technologies at the 5th Digital China Summit.
Distributed storage. Large-object (LOB) storage for the OceanBase distributed database.
